$Comment: Defense XP added to the Great Turkey's hard daily Claim (the Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily_Hard
table), on a server running MMO Skill Tree: the hard twin of Mmo_Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily.
ContributesTo folds this roll into that table without touching its file, so the table's own pay is
tuned there alone. Requires takes this file out on a server without MMO Skill Tree, so the table pays
exactly what its own file says there; always write it with Min 1. A roll with no Chance always pays,
and Amount is XP before any boost.
Name: Mmo_Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily_Hard
